description: Pre-built platform test suite for the Java middleware, authored as Cucumber/Gherkin .feature files run with behave (the format the Java platform team already uses). Covers input validation, JWT/auth handling, JNDI/deserialization guards (Log4Shell), and transport security headers. Each scenario emits its own pass/fail result.

entries.name: Java — credit limit movement validation
entries.description: Applies credit-limit increases/decreases and verifies the arithmetic on the live banking service.
entries.author: Java Platform Team

entries.name: Java — sensitive data protection (PAN masking)
entries.description: Card numbers are masked in list and detail responses.
entries.author: Java Platform Team

entries.name: Java — JNDI/deserialization guard (Log4Shell)
entries.description: A JNDI/deserialization payload is neither reflected nor fatal (CVE-2021-44228).
entries.author: Java Platform Team

entries.name: Java — transport observability headers
entries.description: Every response carries a request-trace header for audit/tracing.
entries.author: Java Platform Team

entries.name: Java — credit card portfolio retrieval
entries.description: Lists the portfolio with masked card numbers and balance fields.
entries.author: Java Platform Team

entries.name: Java — error handling (unknown resource)
entries.description: Requests for non-existent resources return a clean not-found error.
entries.author: Java Platform Team
